name: Savennières

rules.yield_base: 50 hl/ha for dry and medium-dry, 35 for sweeter wines

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

notes: Savennières is a white from Chenin Blanc, today almost always dry.
Its cool climate gives it high acidity, and it is long lived.
The traditional style can be austere and closed when young.
It is fuller bodied than dry Vouvray.

blurb.text: A Loire Valley white wine, usually dry, made from Chenin Blanc on three schist hills on the right bank in Anjou-Saumur.
